highlights.title: Add FreeStyle Libre 3/3+ support
changes: FreeStyle Libre 3/3+ can be selected and paired directly from Trio's CGM settings.
Home glucose view now shows sensor lifecycle details, including warmup countdown and expiry progress.
Alerts generated by the LibreLoop plugin are shown in Trio and routed through the app's alert system.
Libre 3/3+ support is marked experimental and does not provide 1‑minute readings (normal 5‑minute cadence expected).

highlights.title: Updated loop indicator spinner
changes: The loop indicator now shows an animated capsule-style spinner instead of a static label or default progress view.
The looping label is shown only while the spinner is actively animating and is rendered verbatim (not localized).
The spinner animation is smoother and enforces a short minimum spin time to avoid flicker when starting or stopping.
A reusable CapsuleSpinner component replaces the previous spinner and the capsule outline thickness was adjusted for a清.

sources.title: nightscout/Trio#1251: upgrade looping animation and remove looping text

highlights.title: Show release notes in the app
changes: Home now shows a “New Release” panel when your installed version has unread release notes.
Tapping the panel opens a full-sheet that summarizes what changed and any important safety callouts.
Release Notes are also available from Settings, including a list of previous versions to browse.
Notes are fetched from GitHub with a bundled offline fallback so the notes can load without internet.
Tapping the sheet’s acknowledge button hides the Home panel for that specific version; viewing from Settings does not.

highlights.title: Show quick-pick bolus with one decimal
changes: Quick-pick bolus suggestions now display with a single decimal place.
Suggested amounts are floored to one decimal (rounded down) instead of rounded to nearest.
This prevents the suggestion pill from showing two fractional digits.

includedPullRequests.title: Add Libre 3/3+
includedPullRequests.body:
## Summary
  - Integrates the LibreLoop CGM plugin (with adaptations to work with pre `next-dev` LoopKit) so Trio can pair FreeStyle Libre 3 / 3+ sensors directly (no internet reliance, no external app).
  - Ships as three new submodules (`LibreLoop`, `LibreCRKit`, `LoopAlgorithm`) wired through Trio's existing `PluginManager` / `PluginSource` path.
  - Adds Libre 3 / 3+ to the CGM picker and surfaces sensor lifecycle + status highlight on the home glucose view via the shared CGM highlight pipeline.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 1-min readings are currently not supported
> **This is still experimental**

  ## Test plan
  - [x] Fresh install → CGM settings → Libre 3 / 3+ visible in picker
  - [x] Pair a new Libre 3 / 3+ sensor and complete warmup
  - [x] Glucose values arrive on a normal 5-min cadence; no gaps > 6 min under steady conditions
  - [x] Backfill on cold-start / relaunch fills the last 24 h of history
  - [x] Sensor progress bobble on home view matches remaining lifetime; flips to grace period near expiry
  - [x] Alerts from LibreLoop (sensor issue, expiring, expired) show up
  - [x] Swap between Libre 3 / 3+ and another CGM (e.g. G7) and back — no stuck state (watch out, not down Receiver ID before removing Libre) 
  - [x] Loop enacts against Libre readings; no regressions vs. current Trio behaviour
  - [x] Simulator scenarios still work

includedPullRequests.title: Show Release Notes for Installed Trio Version
includedPullRequests.body: ## Summary Surfaces Trio's release notes in two places: - **Home** — a "New Release" entry in the multi-use panel, opening a sheet the user acknowledges to dismiss it - **Settings → Release Notes** — the current release, plus a **Previous Versions** screen for earlier ones ## Where the notes come from Three sources, in order of preference: 1. A live fetch of the GitHub releases API, since notes are sometimes edited after publishing 2. The last successful fetch, cached 3. A copy bundled at build time by `scripts/capture-release-notes.sh` The bundle covers **every stable release back to the last major or minor bump**, building `0.8.4` embeds `0.8.0` through `0.8.4`, so the list still works on a phone that has never been online. That script can never fail a build. A missing release, an unreachable GitHub, an unparseable version or an empty environment all simply leave the fallback out; every path exits 0, and a stale bundle from a previous version is removed rather than left behind. Drafts, prereleases, anything newer than the running build, and anything before `0.8.0` are all excluded. Sorting is by version. ## What the sheet renders The release's opening prose, its GitHub alert callouts, and the bullets under **"What's Changed At A Glance"**. The full notes, including the pull request lists, stay on GitHub behind a link. Two things worth knowing, both found by testing the parser against real releases rather than assuming a format: - **The "At A Glance" heading is not universal.** Five of the six most recent releases have it; the `0.8.3` hotfix used "What happened" / "What's fixed" instead. Relying on that heading alone would have produced an empty sheet on exactly the kind of urgent hotfix people most need to read, so the parser falls back to the release's opening prose. - **Releases carry `[!IMPORTANT]` callouts with safety-relevant content** — *"If you are using Medtrum Nano please update at your earliest convenience"*, *"your active Pod will be automatically transitioned"*. A bullets-only sheet would have hidden these behind a browser link, so they are parsed and shown. ## Acknowledgement Stored per version, so installing a newer release surfaces the panel again with nothing needing to reset it. Only the sheet's button acknowledges — swiping it away, or browsing notes from Settings, leaves the panel in place. The panel ranks below every warning state and above the stats. `MultiUsePanelState.resolve` gained a parameter, so its existing tests were updated and three added for the new ordering; all 10 pass. ### Screenshots | ☾ Release Panel | ☀ Release Panel | Settings Row | Release Notes | |--------|--------|--------|--------| | | | | |
